title: 第19章 机智安排 康昊拜会外婆第20章 外婆的测试
content_zh:
时间过得快，特别是在郑风一伙人吹牛的时候。
船靠岸了，郑风看到最先下的就是一楼购买下等船票的武者，乌泱泱的一群人，很快融入了枫叶林。
郑风一行人没有和人群去挤，待一楼的人走完，二楼的也下得差不多了，缓缓下船，看着宽阔的枫叶林，天团少年还在想数千万上品神晶的事情。
“帅哥，需要到城里住店吗？悦来客栈首屈一指，景观好，客房整洁，大床舒适！”一大妈早就盯上从二楼下来的郑风一行人。
“帅哥需要去购物吗？江枫购物城有城主府监督，品种多，价格透明，童叟无欺，品质有保证！”一中年大叔看着郑风一行人这么多的少年面孔，在一众长辈陪同下，从客船下来，特别留心了郑杰手里的豪华船票。
很多举牌的大叔大妈，上前招揽生意，有客栈酒楼购物城，有很多为卖修行资源的门店拉生意的。
郑风一行人客气回绝，快速穿过枫叶林进城。
康昊可是事先说了，他外婆家就是经营的小生意，开的丹药铺，后来郑风和乔装的康昊赶到一看，这个小生意也太有面了，铺面虽不在城中心，但也十分靠近了，关键是丹药铺数千平米。
一排排玉瓶展示各种丹药，品种众多，摆放有序，琳琅满目。
面积最大的是很多货柜存放的各种药材。郑风放眼一望货柜有近千种药材的名字。
这个景象和康昊说的小本生意也反差太大了，看来自己和康昊有差距，毕竟是神界土生土长的少年，眼界不一样。
郑风发觉此时真有乡巴佬进城的感觉。
郑风忍不住上前仔细打量起来。
“二位小哥需要什么药材或是丹药，常规的药材和丹药本店都有。”一小哥迎着郑风和康昊笑得十分真诚，看来是训练有素。
“若有特殊需要的丹药，本店可以为二位定制。”见郑风看看药材又看看丹药，转了半天，没有搭理他，小哥还是热情的引导，非常的有职业素养。
“听说你们店的老夫人看病特有经验，我们是慕名而来，刚才看遍了全店，都没有看到老夫人，莫非有事情没有来吗？”
“客官若早说，我就早禀告老夫人了，让你久等是我的失职，没有主动介绍情况。”导购小哥连忙传讯，看导购小哥笑得还是那么真诚，心里着实佩服。
“二位客官，老夫人就在后堂，让我一会儿就引你们过去。现在还有点时间，要不我再陪同二位看看丹药或是药材？”小哥不忘继续推销，但口里却并没有提及购买二字，让人感觉舒服。
“这几排都是炼体方面的药材，这也是我们店与其它丹药店不同的特色。金鳞草、霸王果、火焰灵草、天罡灵木、火龙灵果、屠龙晶石更是本店炼体类特有奇珍。”小哥不仅口头介绍还拿起图册展示，生怕郑风听不明白。
郑风这个天元大陆的丹神此时就像初学炼丹识别药草的丹童，认真的听着引导小哥的介绍。还一字不漏的记下来。

在看到天罡灵木和火龙灵果的介绍和图片展示后，他发觉店里展示的还没有自己体内世界的天罡灵木和火龙神果神力充沛。
郑风体内还有雷灵芝、雷灵木等奇珍。郑风面不改色地听着引导小哥介绍了很多药材，为了激发小哥的兴趣，也是感激小哥的热情介绍，郑风都让小哥记下，普通药材来三份，贵重药材各一份。
小哥介绍越发卖力，近千种常规药材都介绍完了，郑风也将这些药材买了个遍。
在一旁的小哥心里乐开了花。康昊忍俊不禁，差点笑得肝疼，还得强忍着，脸上都一抽一抽的，小哥觉得康昊是病得不轻。才想起要引他们过去见老夫人。
“郑风取出一个储物戒，你把已经记下的所有药材都分类标明放到里面，里面的神晶，用不完的就留在里面，若不够再给我说。”
郑风仔细琢磨这些药材，“望、闻、问、感”这是熟悉药材的最后一关，每种药材都看了、闻了、也听小哥介绍了，不清楚的也问了。就差自身对药材的感悟了。
导购小哥动作娴熟，店里的售货员也机灵的帮着打理，很快就清点完毕。
“尊贵的阁下，鉴于你购买的药材数量已达到本店贵宾级，全场药材都打了八折，部分做活动的药材在折扣基础上还打了九折，赠送了几瓶常规丹药已放入阁下提供的储物戒里。”
“这是一张本店最高规格的贵宾卡，下次光临，可继续享受全店八折，部分做活动的药材丹药享折上折优惠。”
“谢谢，需补神晶吗？”郑风一一收好，顺便问了一下。
“不用，由于享受了折扣，客人的神晶还余下不少。我这就引二位去见老夫人。”小哥愈发恭敬，看得出，小哥非常感恩郑风的照顾和信任，是真心的恭敬并非职业性的客套。
三人来到后堂，一个雅致的房间坐着一位鹤发童颜的老妇人，康昊关上门后，取下头罩和面具，“小东西搞得神神秘秘的，淘气！”老人开始以为是来看病的，一看康昊就笑骂起来。
“康昊，长话短说，一会我们就走。”郑风提醒，主动站到了雅间的门外。
content_en:
Time flies, especially when Zheng Feng and his group are bragging.
The ship docked, and Zheng Feng saw that the first people to get off were the warriors who bought tickets for lower-class boats on the first floor. The crowd of people quickly blended into the maple leaf forest.
Zheng Feng and his party did not join the crowd. After the people on the first floor had finished walking, and the people on the second floor were almost done, they slowly got off the boat and looked at the vast maple leaf forest. The Tiantuan boy was still thinking about tens of millions of high-grade divine crystals.
"Handsome guy, do you need to stay in a hotel in the city? The Yuelai Inn is second to none, with a great view, clean guest rooms, and comfortable big beds!" The aunt had already set her sights on Zheng Feng and his group who came down from the second floor.
"Handsome guy, do you need to go shopping? Jiangfeng Shopping City is supervised by the city lord's government. There are many varieties, the prices are transparent, the children are innocent, and the quality is guaranteed!" A middle-aged uncle looked at the many young faces of Zheng Feng and his group. Accompanied by a group of elders, he got off the passenger ship and paid special attention to the luxury ticket in Zheng Jie's hand.
Many uncles and aunties holding placards came forward to solicit business. There were inns, restaurants, shopping malls, and many stores selling spiritual resources.
Zheng Feng and his party politely declined and quickly walked through the maple forest into the city.
Kang Hao had said in advance that his grandmother's family was running a small business, an elixir shop. Later, Zheng Feng and Kang Hao in disguise came to take a look and found that this small business was very popular. Although the shop was not in the center of the city, it was very close. The key was that the elixir shop covered thousands of square meters.
Rows of jade bottles display various elixirs, with many varieties, arranged in an orderly manner, and a dazzling array.
The largest area is the various medicinal materials stored in many containers. Zheng Feng glanced at the container and saw the names of nearly a thousand medicinal materials.
This scene is also in great contrast with the small business that Kang Hao said. It seems that there is a gap between him and Kang Hao. After all, he is a young man born and raised in the God Realm, and his vision is different.
Zheng Feng found that it felt like a country bumpkin entering the city at this time.
Zheng Feng couldn't help but stepped forward and looked at it carefully.
"What kind of medicinal materials or elixirs do you two need? We have regular medicinal materials and elixirs in our store." The younger brother smiled very sincerely at Zheng Feng and Kang Hao, and it seemed that he was well-trained.
"If there are special needs for elixirs, our store can customize them for you two." Zheng Feng looked at the medicinal materials and then the elixirs for a long time without paying attention to him. The little brother still guided him enthusiastically and was very professional.
"I heard that the old lady in your store has special experience in treating doctors. We came here because of her reputation. We just looked through the whole store and we didn't see the old lady. Is there something that didn't come to her?"
"If the guest had told me earlier, I would have reported it to the old lady. It was my dereliction of duty to keep you waiting. I did not take the initiative to introduce the situation." The shopping guide hurriedly sent the message. Seeing that the shopping guide's smile was still so sincere, I was really impressed.
"Two guests, the old lady is in the back hall. Let me lead you there in a moment. There is still some time now, how about I accompany you two to look at the elixirs or medicinal materials?" The little brother did not forget to continue selling, but he did not mention the word "purchase" in his mouth, which made people feel comfortable.
"These rows are filled with medicinal materials for body refining, which is what makes our store different from other elixir shops. Golden Scale Grass, Overlord Fruit, Flame Spirit Grass, Tiangang Spirit Wood, Fire Dragon Spirit Fruit, and Dragon Slaying Crystal are the unique treasures of our store for body refining." The little brother not only introduced verbally, but also picked up the picture book to show it, for fear that Zheng Feng wouldn't understand.
Zheng Feng, the alchemy god of Tianyuan Continent, was like a new alchemy boy learning to make alchemy and identify medicinal herbs, listening carefully to the introduction of the guide. I also wrote it down word for word.
After seeing the introduction and picture display of Tiangang Spirit Wood and Fire Dragon Spirit Fruit, he found that the ones displayed in the store were not as powerful as the Tiangang Spirit Wood and Fire Dragon Fruit in his own body.
There are also rare treasures such as Lei Lingzhi and Lei Lingmu in Zheng Feng's body. Zheng Feng listened calmly as the guide introduced many medicinal materials. In order to stimulate the interest of the young man and to thank the young man for his enthusiastic introduction, Zheng Feng asked the young brother to write down three portions of ordinary medicinal materials and one portion each of precious medicinal materials.
BrotherThe introduction became more and more diligent, and nearly a thousand conventional medicinal materials were introduced. Zheng Feng also bought all these medicinal materials.
The little brother on the side was very happy. Kang Hao couldn't help laughing. He almost laughed so hard that his liver hurt. He had to hold it in and his face was twitching. The little brother felt that Kang Hao was seriously ill. Only then did he think of luring them over to see the old lady.
"Zheng Feng took out a storage ring. You put all the medicinal materials that you have written down into categories and labels. If you can't use up the divine crystals in it, keep them in it. If there are not enough, let me know."
Zheng Feng carefully considered these medicinal materials. "Looking, smelling, asking, and feeling" was the last step in getting familiar with the medicinal materials. He saw, smelled, and listened to the little brother's introduction to each medicinal material. He also asked questions if he was unclear. The only thing missing is my own understanding of medicinal materials.
The shopping guide acted skillfully, and the salesperson in the store also helped with the work smartly, and the inventory was quickly completed.
"Your Excellency, since the quantity of medicinal materials you purchased has reached the VIP level in our store, all medicinal materials are discounted by 20%. Some medicinal materials for the event are discounted by 10% on the basis of the discount. Several bottles of conventional elixirs have been put into the storage ring provided by you."
"This is the highest-level VIP card in our store. Next time you visit, you can continue to enjoy a 20% discount on the entire store, and some medicinal herbs and elixirs for special events can be discounted at an additional discount."
"Thank you. Do you need to replenish the divine crystals?" Zheng Feng put them away one by one and asked by the way.
"No, because of the discount, the guests still have a lot of divine crystals left. I will lead you two to see the old lady." The younger brother became more and more respectful. It can be seen that the younger brother is very grateful to Zheng Feng for his care and trust. He is sincerely respectful and not a professional politeness.
The three of them came to the back hall, where an old woman with gray hair and childish face sat in an elegant room. After Kang Hao closed the door, he took off his hood and mask, "The little thing is acting mysterious and naughty!" The old man thought at first that he was here to see a doctor, and he laughed and cursed when he saw Kang Hao.
"Kang Hao, to make a long story short, we will leave in a moment." Zheng Feng reminded, taking the initiative to stand outside the door of the private room.
